source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 3 exercise hal (PDF 70-73): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, structures lafzon mein, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Chemical Bonding) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain. Structure aur diagram wale sawalon mein drawing lafzon mein bayan ki gayi hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. Chemical bond formation takes place when
(Chemical bond kab banta hai?)

options.text: jab kashish ki quwwat dhakelne (repulsion) ki quwwat ke barabar ho
jab repulsion kashish se zyada ho
jab kashish repulsion par ghalib aa jaye

blocks.explanation: Bond tab banta hai jab kashish (nuclei aur electrons ke darmiyan) repulsion par ghalib aa jaye; energy kam hoti hai aur jure atoms alag atoms se zyada mustahkam hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) mein "are" aur "force or repulsion" chhapa hai; murad hai "force of attraction is equal to the force of repulsion".

blocks.prompt:
II. An ionic compound A⁺B⁻ is most likely to be formed when
(Ionic compound A⁺B⁻ sab se zyada kab banega?)

options.text: A ki ionization energy zyada aur B ki electron affinity kam ho.
A ki ionization energy kam aur B ki electron affinity zyada ho.
A ki ionization energy aur B ki electron affinity dono zyada hon.
A ki ionization energy aur B ki electron affinity dono kam hon.

blocks.explanation: Ionic bond kam ionization energy wale atom (A asani se A⁺ banata hai) se zyada electron affinity wale atom (B asani se B⁻ banata hai) ki taraf electrons ki mukammal muntaqili se banta hai (3.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which of the following molecules has zero dipole moment?
(Kis molecule ka dipole moment sifar (zero) hai?)
blocks.explanation: BF₃ trigonal planar aur hamwaar (symmetrical) hai; teen B–F bond moments aik doosre ko khatam kar dete hain, is liye dipole moment sifar. NH₃ (pyramidal), CHCl₃ (be-tarteeb) aur H₂O (bent) polar hain.

blocks.prompt:
IV. The numbers of σ and π bonds in the N₂ molecule are:
(N₂ molecule mein σ aur π bonds kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: N≡N triple bond hai: aik σ (2px ka seedha overlap) aur do π bonds (2py aur 2pz ka pehlu se overlap); bond order 3 (3.6.1).

blocks.prompt:
V. Which of the following species has unpaired electrons in antibonding molecular orbitals?
(Kis specie ke antibonding molecular orbitals mein unpaired electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: N₂²⁻ ke 16 electrons hain, O₂ ki tarah: aakhri do electrons akele akele π*2py aur π*2pz mein jaate hain (Hund), is liye do unpaired antibonding electrons. O₂²⁺ (14 electrons, N₂ jaisa) ke π* khali; F₂ ke π* poore bhare (paired); B₂ ke unpaired electrons bonding π mein hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein sirf "B" (boron atom) chhapa hai; murad B₂ molecule hai. Dono ke antibonding orbitals mein unpaired electrons nahi, is liye jawab wahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. The shape of ICl₃ according to the VSEPR model is:
(VSEPR model ke mutabiq ICl₃ ki shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: I ke 7 valence electrons: 3 bond pairs (I–Cl) aur 2 lone pairs, kul 5 pairs (AB₅ type). Electron pair geometry trigonal bipyramidal; do lone pairs tikon (triangle) mein, is liye atoms T-shape banate hain (chapter mein AB₅ ki misalein PCl₅ aur I₃⁻ hain; T-shape chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
VII. Which of the following shows incorrect bond polarity?
(Kis mein bond polarity ghalat dikhayi gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Br–Br do aik jaise atoms ka bond hai, electronegativity barabar, is liye non-polar aur koi partial charge nahi (3.1.2). H–F, Cl–O aur C–O mein zyada electronegative atom (F 4.0, O 3.5) durust tor par δ− hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which of the following molecules has a dipole moment?
(Kis molecule ka dipole moment hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ mura hua (bent) hai (S par aik lone pair), is liye S=O bond moments khatam nahi hote: 1.61 D. CO₂ aur CS₂ seedhe (linear) aur CCl₄ tetrahedral hain; in ke bond moments khatam ho jaate hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX. How many electrons are present in the valence shell of P in PO₄³⁻?
(PO₄³⁻ mein P ke valence shell mein kitne electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Lewis structure mein P ka aik P=O double bond aur teen P–O⁻ single bonds:
electrons = double bond ke 4 + 3 × 2 = 10
Yani P ka octet 2 se barha hua (expanded) hai; chapter PO₄³⁻ ko expanded octet mein ginta hai (3.1.4).

blocks.prompt:
X. How many extra electrons than a normal octet are there in the valence shell of I in ICl₅?
(ICl₅ mein I ke valence shell mein octet se kitne zyada electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation:
I apne 7 valence electrons mein se 5 paanch I–Cl bonds mein lagata hai aur aik lone pair rakhta hai:
I ke gird electrons = 5 × 2 + 2 = 12
12 − 8 = 4 zyada electrons.

blocks.prompt:
XI. What is the type and shape of [ICl₄]⁻ according to the VSEPR model?
(VSEPR model ke mutabiq [ICl₄]⁻ ki type aur shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: I (7 electrons) + charge ka 1 = 8: chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs, kul chhe pairs. XeF₄ (3.3.2) ki tarah AB₆ system: octahedral electron pair geometry, lone pairs 180° par, shakal square planar, 90° angles.

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which type of hybridization of C occurs in CO₂?
(CO₂ mein C ki hybridization kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: C do σ bonds (har O se aik) aur do π bonds banata hai, koi lone pair nahi; do electron regions se do sp hybrid orbitals 180° par: seedha O=C=O.

blocks.prompt:
XIII. Which of the following molecules has a central atom with sp3 hybridization and a tetrahedral electron pair geometry?
(Kis molecule ka markazi atom sp³ hybridized hai aur electron pair geometry tetrahedral hai?)
blocks.explanation: CCl₄ mein carbon sp³ hybrid orbitals se chaar σ bonds banata hai: tetrahedral, 109.5° (3.3.2, 3.5.1). BF₃ sp² (trigonal), SO₂ trigonal (angular), PCl₅ trigonal bipyramidal.

blocks.prompt:
XIV. Which of the following species contains a dative bond?
(Kis specie mein dative bond hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₄⁺ mein NH₃ ka N apna lone pair H⁺ (jis ke paas koi electron nahi) ko deta hai: coordinate (dative) bond, jaise H₂O + H⁺ → H₃O⁺ (3.13). CH₄ aur O₂ mein aam covalent bonds; NaCl ionic hai.

blocks.text: Q.2 Darj zail sawalon ke mukhtasar jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Define the following:
(i) Dipole (ii) Bond order (iii) Permanent dipole- permanent dipole force (iv) London dispersion force
In ki tareef karein: (i) Dipole (ii) Bond order (iii) Permanent dipole-permanent dipole force (iv) London dispersion force
blocks.explanation:
(i) Dipole: woh molecule jis ke aik hisse par partial positive (δ⁺) aur doosre par partial negative (δ⁻) charge ho, misal Hᵟ⁺–Fᵟ⁻.
(ii) Bond order: do atoms ke darmiyan bonds ki tadaad = (bonding electrons − antibonding electrons)/2; misal N₂ = 3.
(iii) Permanent dipole-permanent dipole force: aik polar molecule ke δ⁺ sire aur parosi polar molecule ke δ⁻ sire ki kashish, misal HCl; 5-20 kJ mol⁻¹.
(iv) London dispersion force: aik molecule ke lamhati (instantaneous) dipole aur us se parosi mein paida (induced) dipole ki kamzor kashish; har molecule mein, misal Cl₂, noble gases; 1-20 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
b. Draw the Lewis (electron dot) structures for the following species:
(i) HCN (ii) NCl₃ (iii) CO (iv) O₃ (v) NO₂
In ke Lewis (electron dot) structures banayein: (i) HCN (ii) NCl₃ (iii) CO (iv) O₃ (v) NO₂
blocks.explanation:
(i) HCN (10 valence electrons): H–C≡N: ; H–C mein aik pair, C≡N mein teen pairs, N par aik lone pair.
(ii) NCl₃ (26): beech mein N, teen N–Cl single bonds aur aik lone pair; har Cl par teen lone pairs.
(iii) CO (10): :C≡O: ; teen shared pairs (in mein se aik O ne diya, dative bond) aur har atom par aik lone pair.
(iv) O₃ (18): O=O⁺–O⁻ ; beech wale O par aik lone pair, double bond wale O par do, single bond wale O par teen lone pairs (O–O dative bond hai).
(v) NO₂ (17, taaq electrons): O=N–O ; N par aik unpaired electron, double bond wale O par do aur single bond wale O par teen lone pairs (N ke paas sirf 7 electrons).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lewis structure banane ka tareeqa: (1) kul valence electrons ginein; (2) markazi atom ko baqi se single bonds se jorein; (3) baqi electrons bahar ke atoms par lone pairs ki shakal mein rakhein; (4) markazi atom ka octet poora na ho to lone pair se double/triple bond banayein.

blocks.prompt:
c. Xenon ist a noble gas (group 18); xenon trioxide has the following structure:
(Structure printed: Xe at the top with one lone pair, joined by double bonds to three O atoms below it.)
i. By counting electron pairs around the central atom, explain why xenon trioxide has this shape.
ii Draw a structure of xenon trioxide showing partial charges on the atoms and the direction of the dipole in the molecule.
Xenon noble gas (group 18) hai; xenon trioxide ka structure diya gaya hai. i. Markazi atom ke gird electron pairs gin kar is shakal ki wajah batayein. ii. Partial charges aur dipole ke rukh ke saath XeO₃ ka structure banayein.
blocks.explanation:
i. Xe ke 8 valence electrons; 6 teen Xe=O double bonds mein aur 2 aik lone pair ke tor par. Yani chaar electron regions (har double bond aik gina jata hai): tetrahedral electron pair geometry. Lone pair chhor kar XeO₃ trigonal pyramidal hai, O–Xe–O angles 109.5° se kam (lone pair ka dhakelna).
ii. Wahi pyramid banayein: oopar Xe par δ⁺, neeche har O par δ⁻ (O zyada electronegative). Bond moments axis par jama hote hain; dipole δ⁺ Xe se δ⁻ oxygen wale base ki taraf (kitab dipole δ⁺ se δ⁻ ki taraf dikhati hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "Xenon ist a noble gas" chhapa hai; sahi "Xenon is a noble gas" hai.

blocks.prompt:
d. Explain the difference between the formation of σ and π bonds.
σ aur π bonds ke banne mein farq wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: σ bond nuclear axis par seedhe (head-on) overlap se, π bond mutawazi p orbitals ke pehlu (sideways) overlap se banta hai (3.4.1).

rows: s-s, s-p, p-p ya hybrid orbitals se
Density axis ke oopar neeche; axis par nahi
Mazboot; pehle banta hai; single bond σ
Kamzor; σ ke baad banta hai (double, triple bonds)

blocks.prompt:
e. The structure of propanone (acetone) is:
(Structure printed: a central C double-bonded to O above it and single-bonded to two CH₃ groups, H₃C and CH₃.)
i. Show how the central carbon atom forms σ and π bonds through hybridization.
ii. Can propanone make a hydrogen bond with water when both are intermixed?
Propanone (acetone) ka structure diya gaya hai. i. Hybridization se markazi carbon ke σ aur π bonds dikhayein. ii. Kya propanone pani ke saath hydrogen bond bana sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
i. Markazi C sp² hybridized hai (2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹ → teen sp² + aik 2pz). Teen sp² orbitals (trigonal planar, 120°) teen σ bonds banate hain: do CH₃ carbons se aur aik O se. C ka bacha hua 2pz O ke 2p se pehlu (sideways) overlap kar ke π bond banata hai; yun C=O = σ + π.
ii. Haan. C=O ka O δ⁻ hai aur us par do lone pairs hain, is liye pani ka δ⁺ H us se hydrogen bond banata hai (O–H···O=C); isi liye propanone pani mein mil jata hai. (Propanone khud apne aap se H-bond nahi banata: us ke O par H nahi.)

blocks.prompt:
f. Predict the shapes of sulfate ([SO₄]²⁻, borate ([BH₄]⁻) and tri-iodide ions ([I₃]⁻) according to the VSEPR model.
VSEPR model se sulfate ([SO₄]²⁻), [BH₄]⁻ aur tri-iodide ([I₃]⁻) ions ki shaklein batayein.
blocks.explanation:
[SO₄]²⁻: chaar S–O bonding regions (do S=O, do S–O⁻), koi lone pair nahi: tetrahedral, 109.5°.
[BH₄]⁻: B (3 electrons + charge ka 1) chaar B–H bond pairs banata hai, koi lone pair nahi: tetrahedral, 109.5°.
[I₃]⁻: markazi I par 2 bond pairs + 3 lone pairs (AB₅): electron pair geometry trigonal bipyramidal; lone pairs tikon mein, is liye shakal seedhi (linear), 180°.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: [BH₄]⁻ ko "borate" likha hai; yeh tetrahydroborate (borohydride) ion hai. Borate boron ka oxygen wala ion hai jaise BO₃³⁻. "sulfate ([SO₄]²⁻" ke baad bracket bhi band nahi kiya gaya.

blocks.prompt:
g. Sketch the molecular orbital pictures of π(2p) and π*(2p).
π(2p) aur π*(2p) molecular orbitals ki tasveer banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Do nuclei par do mutawazi 2p orbitals (maslan 2py) banayein, nuclear axis ke amudi.
π(2p), bonding: aik jaise sign ke lobes pehlu se milte hain; axis ke oopar aik aur neeche aik electron cloud, axis par density sifar (nodal plane); energy kam.
π*(2p), antibonding: ulte sign ke lobes milte hain; chaar alag lobes aur nuclei ke darmiyan aik izafi node; nuclei ke beech density sab se kam; energy zyada.

blocks.prompt:
h. Sketch the hybrid orbitals and bond formation in PCl₃, SiCl₄, and NH₄⁺.
PCl₃, SiCl₄ aur NH₄⁺ mein hybrid orbitals aur bonds ka banna dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
PCl₃: P (3s² 3p³) sp³: chaar sp³ orbitals, teen aadhe bhare teen Cl ke 3p se overlap (σ), chauthe mein lone pair: pyramidal, angle 109.5° se kam.
SiCl₄: Si (3s² 3p² → excited 3s¹ 3p³) sp³: chaar aadhe bhare sp³ chaar Cl ke 3p se overlap: tetrahedral, 109.5°.
NH₄⁺: N (2s² 2p³) sp³: teen aadhe bhare sp³ teen H ke 1s se overlap; lone pair wala sp³ H⁺ ko diya jata hai (dative bond): tetrahedral, 109.5°, chaaron N–H bonds aik jaise.

blocks.prompt:
i. The structures of PF₃ and SiF₄ are given below. Redraw these with partial charges and state which is polar and which is non-polar.
(Structures printed: PF₃ with P at the top bonded to three F atoms below it; SiF₄ with Si in the centre bonded to four F atoms.)
PF₃ aur SiF₄ ke structures diye gaye hain. Inhein partial charges ke saath dobara banayein aur batayein kaun polar aur kaun non-polar hai.
blocks.explanation:
PF₃: Pᵟ⁺ aur teen Fᵟ⁻; P par lone pair hai, is liye molecule pyramidal aur bond moments khatam nahi hote: polar.
SiF₄: Siᵟ⁺ aur chaar Fᵟ⁻; molecule bilkul tetrahedral, chaar barabar bond moments khatam: non-polar.

blocks.prompt:
j. Draw the orbital structures of the CO₂ molecule in terms of VBT.
VBT ke mutabiq CO₂ ka orbital structure banayein.
blocks.explanation:
C (excited 2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹) sp hybridized: do sp orbitals 180° par aur bache hue 2py, 2pz.
σ bonds: har sp orbital aik O ke aadhe bhare 2p se seedha overlap karta hai (do C–O σ bonds, linear).
π bonds: C ka 2py aik O ke 2py se, aur C ka 2pz doosre O ke 2pz se pehlu se overlap karta hai; do π bonds aik doosre ke amudi planes mein. Yun O=C=O, linear, 180°.

blocks.prompt:
k. Draw the Lewis structures and tell whether these ions involve expanded octets?
i) ClO₄⁻ ii) ICl₄⁻ iii) NH₄⁺ iv) I₃⁻
In ions ke Lewis structures banayein aur batayein kya in mein expanded octet hai: i) ClO₄⁻ ii) ICl₄⁻ iii) NH₄⁺ iv) I₃⁻
blocks.explanation:
i) ClO₄⁻: Cl ke teen Cl=O aur aik Cl–O⁻ (jaise kitab SO₄²⁻ banati hai): Cl ke gird 3(4) + 2 = 14 electrons: expanded.
ii) ICl₄⁻: I ke chaar I–Cl bonds aur do lone pairs: 12 electrons: expanded.
iii) NH₄⁺: N ke chaar N–H bonds, koi lone pair nahi: 8 electrons: expanded nahi (N period 2 ka hai, d orbitals nahi).
iv) I₃⁻: beech wale I ke do I–I bonds aur teen lone pairs: 10 electrons: expanded.

blocks.prompt:
l. The bond between K and Cl is ionic but that between Si and Cl is polar covalent. Explain why.
K aur Cl ka bond ionic hai magar Si aur Cl ka polar covalent. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Electronegativity ka farq bond ki qisam tay karta hai (3.2):
K–Cl: 3.0 − 0.8 = 2.2 (1.8 se zyada): electron muntaqil, ionic.
Si–Cl: 3.0 − 1.8 = 1.2 (0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan): electrons na-barabar share, polar covalent.

blocks.prompt:
m. SO₂ is a polar molecule but SO₃ not. Justify.
SO₂ polar hai magar SO₃ nahi. Sabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
SO₂: S par aik lone pair use mura hua (V-shape, 120° se kam) banata hai, is liye do S=O bond moments khatam nahi hote: dipole moment 1.61 D, polar.
SO₃: teen S=O bonds, koi lone pair nahi: hamwaar trigonal planar (120°); teen bond moments khatam: dipole moment sifar, non-polar.

blocks.prompt:
n. Which of O₂²⁺, and O₂²⁻ would be paramagnetic? Give reason in the light of MOT.
O₂²⁺ aur O₂²⁻ mein se kaun paramagnetic hoga? MOT ki roshni mein wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Koi bhi nahi. O₂ wali tarteeb σ2s < σ*2s < σ2px < π2py = π2pz < π*2py = π*2pz se:
O₂²⁺ (14 electrons): σ2s² σ*2s² σ2px² π2py² π2pz²; π* khali, sab paired: diamagnetic, bond order 3.
O₂²⁻ (18 electrons): … π*2py² π*2pz²; π* bhare, sab paired: diamagnetic, bond order 1.
(O₂, O₂⁺ aur O₂⁻ ke π* mein unpaired electrons hain, woh paramagnetic hain.)

blocks.prompt:
o. Which of the following bonds would be most polar?
i) C-Cl ii) Si-F iii) Se-F
Kaun sa bond sab se zyada polar hoga? i) C-Cl ii) Si-F iii) Se-F
blocks.explanation:
Si–F, kyun ke is ka electronegativity farq sab se zyada hai:
C–Cl: 3.0 − 2.5 = 0.5
Si–F: 4.0 − 1.8 = 2.2
Se–F: 4.0 − 2.4 = 1.6 (Se ki 2.4 value chapter se bahar hai)

blocks.prompt:
p. What are necessary conditions for the hydrogen bond to form?
Hydrogen bond banne ki zaroori sharait kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. H kisi chhote, bohat electronegative atom (F, O ya N) se covalent bond mein jura ho, taake us par zyada δ⁺ charge ho.
2. Qareeb hi lone pair wala doosra chhota, bohat electronegative atom (F, O, N) ho jo us H ko kheenche, misal H₂O, HF, NH₃ (tafseel states of matter wale chapter mein).

blocks.prompt:
q. Compare the bond energies of single, double, and triple bonds between the same two atoms (e.g., H-H, O=O, O≡O). Explain the trend in terms of the number of shared electrons.
Aik hi do atoms ke darmiyan single, double aur triple bonds ki bond energies ka muqabla karein aur shared electrons ki tadaad se trend samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Aik hi do atoms ke darmiyan: triple > double > single, misal C≡C 839 > C=C 614 > C–C 347 kJ mol⁻¹ (Table 3.2).
Single bond mein 2, double mein 4 aur triple mein 6 electrons share hote hain. Nuclei ke darmiyan zyada shared electrons zyada kashish dete hain, is liye bond torne ke liye zyada energy chahiye aur bond chhota hota hai (C–C 154, C=C 133, C≡C 120 pm). Barhotri do guna ya teen guna se kam hai kyun ke π bonds σ bond se kamzor hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Misalein "H-H, O=O, O≡O" chhapi hain. Yeh aik hi do atoms ki series nahi (H–H alag jora hai), aur O≡O ka wajood nahi: oxygen O=O (495 kJ mol⁻¹) banata hai. Aik hi do atoms ki durust series C–C, C=C, C≡C (347, 614, 839 kJ mol⁻¹) hai, chapter ke Table 3.2 se.

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 How the bonding in the following molecules can be explained with respect to valence bond theory?
(i) Cl₂ (ii) O₂ (iii) N₂ (iv) HF (v) H₂S
Valence bond theory ke mutabiq in molecules mein bonding kaise samjhayi jati hai? (i) Cl₂ (ii) O₂ (iii) N₂ (iv) HF (v) H₂S
blocks.explanation:
VBT: do atoms ke milti julti energy wale aadhe bhare valence orbitals overlap karein to covalent bond banta hai; zyada overlap, mazboot bond; bonds ka khaas rukh hota hai.
(i) Cl₂: Cl = [Ne] 3s² 3px² 3py² 3pz¹. Do Cl atoms ke aadhe bhare 3pz nuclear axis par seedha overlap karte hain (p-p overlap): aik σ bond, Cl–Cl. Density barabar (electronegativity barabar): non-polar.
(ii) O₂: O = 1s² 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz²(pair). Aadhe bhare 2px sire se sira overlap: σ bond. Aadhe bhare 2py mutawazi hain aur pehlu se, axis ke oopar neeche, overlap karte hain: π bond. Yun O=O (aik σ + aik π).
(iii) N₂: N = 1s² 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹. 2px–2px seedha overlap: σ bond; 2py–2py aur 2pz–2pz pehlu ka overlap: amudi planes mein do π bonds. Yun N≡N (aik σ + do π), bohat mazboot bond.
(iv) HF: H ka aadha bhara 1s F ke aadhe bhare 2p se overlap (s-p overlap): σ bond. F zyada electronegative, density F ke qareeb zyada: Hᵟ⁺–Fᵟ⁻, polar.
(v) H₂S: S = [Ne] 3s² 3px² 3py¹ 3pz¹. Do aadhe bhare 3p (3py, 3pz, 90° par) har aik H ke 1s se overlap (s-p): do σ bonds. Molecule V-shape, H–S–H angle 92° (p orbitals ke 90° ke qareeb).

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 What are the postulates of VSEPR model? Discuss the structures of the following species with reference to this theory.
(i) CH₄ (ii) NH₃ (iii) H₃O⁺ (iv) PCl₅ (v) SO₂ (vi) SF₆
VSEPR model ke postulates kya hain? Is theory ki roshni mein in species ke structures bayan karein: (i) CH₄ (ii) NH₃ (iii) H₃O⁺ (iv) PCl₅ (v) SO₂ (vi) SF₆
blocks.explanation:
VSEPR (Sidgwick aur Powell, 1940): molecule woh shakal leta hai jis mein markazi atom ke valence electron pairs ki repulsion sab se kam ho.
Postulates:
1. Lone pairs aur bond pairs dono geometry tay karte hain.
2. Electron pairs markazi atom ke gird jitna ho sake door door rehte hain.
3. Lone pairs bond pairs se zyada jagah lete hain aur bond angles ko dabate hain.
4. Repulsion ki tarteeb: lone pair-lone pair > lone pair-bond pair > bond pair-bond pair.
5. Double ya triple bond ko aik electron pair (region) gina jata hai.
6. Markazi atom par bohat electronegative atoms bond pairs ki repulsion kam karte hain.
Electron pair geometry kul pairs se, aur shakal sirf atoms se (lone pairs chhor kar) tay hoti hai.
(i) CH₄ (AB₄, 4 bond pairs, 0 lone pair): tetrahedral, H–C–H 109.5°.
(ii) NH₃ (4 pairs: 3 bond, 1 lone): tetrahedral electron pair geometry, trigonal pyramidal shakal, 107°.
(iii) H₃O⁺ (H₂O + H⁺; 4 pairs: 3 bond, 1 lone): tetrahedral geometry, NH₃ jaisi trigonal pyramidal shakal.
(iv) PCl₅ (AB₅, 5 bond pairs, 0 lone): trigonal bipyramidal; tikon mein 120°, axial aur equatorial ke darmiyan 90°.
(v) SO₂ (3 regions: do S=O, aik lone pair): trigonal electron pair geometry, angular (V-shape), angle 120° se kam; dipole moment 1.61 D.
(vi) SF₆ (AB₆, 6 bond pairs, 0 lone): octahedral, tamam F–S–F angles 90°.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Explain the orbital hybridization for CH₄, NH₃, BF₃, and BeCl₂.
CH₄, NH₃, BF₃ aur BeCl₂ ki orbital hybridization wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Hybridization: aik atom ke thori mukhtalif energy aur shakal wale atomic orbitals ka mil kar utne hi barabar energy aur shakal wale hybrid orbitals banana.
CH₄ (sp³): C 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ → excited 2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹. Aik 2s aur teen 2p mil kar chaar sp³ orbitals, har aik mein aik electron, tetrahedron ke kono ki taraf. Har aik H ke 1s se overlap (sp³-s): chaar σ bonds; tetrahedral, 109.5°.
NH₃ (sp³): N 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹ se chaar sp³ orbitals; aik mein lone pair, teen aadhe bhare teen H ke 1s se overlap. Lone pair bond pairs ko dhakelta hai: pyramidal, 107°.
BF₃ (sp²): B 2s² 2px¹ → excited 2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹. Aik 2s aur do 2p mil kar teen sp² orbitals aik plane mein 120° par; har aik F ke aadhe bhare 2pz se overlap (sp²-p): trigonal planar, 120°; B par aik khali 2p bachta hai.
BeCl₂ (sp): Be 2s² → excited 2s¹ 2px¹. Aik 2s aur aik 2p mil kar do sp orbitals 180° par; har aik Cl ke aadhe bhare 3p se overlap: seedha Cl–Be–Cl, 180°.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Draw the molecular orbital diagrams of the following molecules. Calculate their bond orders?
(i) H₂ (ii) He₂ iii) N₂ (iv) O₂
In molecules ke molecular orbital diagrams banayein aur bond orders nikalein: (i) H₂ (ii) He₂ (iii) N₂ (iv) O₂
blocks.explanation:
Har diagram mein do atoms ke atomic orbitals baen aur daen, molecular orbitals beech mein (bonding neeche, antibonding oopar), energy ka arrow oopar ki taraf, aur electrons neeche se bharein (Pauli, Hund).
Bond order = (bonding electrons − antibonding electrons)/2
(i) H₂ (2 electrons): σ1s². Bond order = (2 − 0)/2 = 1 (single bond, diamagnetic).
(ii) He₂ (4 electrons): σ1s² σ*1s². Bond order = (2 − 2)/2 = 0, is liye He₂ nahi banta.
(iii) N₂ (valence 10 electrons; 1s electrons chhor dein): σ2s² σ*2s² π2py² π2pz² σ2px² (tarteeb σ2s < σ*2s < π2py = π2pz < σ2px < π*2p < σ*2px). Bond order = (8 − 2)/2 = 3: N≡N, aik σ + do π; sab paired, diamagnetic.
(iv) O₂ (valence 12 electrons): σ2s² σ*2s² σ2px² π2py² π2pz² π*2py¹ π*2pz¹ (tarteeb σ2s < σ*2s < σ2px < π2p < π*2p < σ*2px). Bond order = (8 − 4)/2 = 2: O=O. Do unpaired π* electrons O₂ ko paramagnetic banate hain (liquid O₂ magnet ke poles ke darmiyan atak jati hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter N₂ ka bond order (6 − 0)/2 = 3 sirf 2p wale electrons se nikalta hai; σ2s aur σ*2s ko bhi ginein to (8 − 2)/2 = 3, jawab wahi. O₂ ke liye bhi (6 − 2)/2 = (8 − 4)/2 = 2.

blocks.prompt:
Q.7 Discuss the formation of F₂ molecule in the light of Lewis concept, VBT, and MOT.
F₂ molecule ka banna Lewis concept, VBT aur MOT ki roshni mein bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
F = 1s² 2s² 2px² 2py² 2pz¹ (7 valence electrons).
1. Lewis concept: har F ko octet poora karne ke liye aik electron chahiye. Dono atoms aik pair share karte hain: F–F, single covalent bond; phir har F par teen lone pairs aur aath valence electrons (neon jaisi configuration). Bond non-polar (electronegativity barabar).
2. VBT: aik F ka aadha bhara 2pz doosre F ke aadhe bhare 2pz se nuclear axis par seedha overlap karta hai (p-p overlap): aik σ bond, Cl₂ ki tarah. Bhare hue 2s, 2px, 2py lone pairs rehte hain.
3. MOT: 14 valence electrons yun bharte hain: σ2s² σ*2s² σ2px² π2py² π2pz² π*2py² π*2pz² (σ*2px khali).
Bond order = (bonding − antibonding)/2 = (8 − 6)/2 = 1: single bond, Lewis aur VBT ki tarah. Sab electrons paired, is liye F₂ diamagnetic. Zyada antibonding electrons F–F bond ki kamzori batate hain (154 kJ mol⁻¹, Table 3.2).
